title: DayPlay SF Bay Area Local Intelligence
description: Query DayPlay's verified real-time dataset: places, events, neighborhood centroids, or a fully composed outing itinerary with walk legs. Strictly San Francisco, Oakland, and Berkeley.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: plan calls get_events and get_places and builds a walk itinerary. events, places, and neighborhoods call those MCP tools. Set tool to call any other of the 40 tools.

neighborhood.title: Neighborhood
neighborhood.description: Exact SF Bay Area neighborhood name (e.g. Mission, North Beach, Oakland, Berkeley — see the neighborhoods list at dayplay.io). Out-of-market names are refused by protocol — DayPlay never invents venues.

date.title: Date
date.description: Outing or event date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in America/Los_Angeles when omitted.

interests.title: Interests
interests.description: Optional comma-separated interests (e.g. music, food, art, comedy). Applied in events, places, and plan mode. If nothing matches, the result is empty.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Optional budget tier for plan mode.

maxStops.title: Max stops (plan mode)
maxStops.description: Maximum number of stops in a composed itinerary.

tool.title: MCP tool
tool.description: Optional. When set, this exact tool from https://api.dayplay.io/mcp is called and mode is ignored. Example: get_happening_today.

accessToken.title: Dayplay access token
accessToken.description: User bearer token from Google connect. Required for gated tools such as plan_outing, search_smart, and saves.

limit.title: Record limit (events/places mode)
limit.description: Max records returned in events or places mode.
